title: get_registry

token_id.description: Registry token key (reg.tokens), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. bitcoin:BTC in «Bitcoin (BTC) · bitcoin:BTC».

entity_id.description: Registry entity key (reg.entities), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. uniswap in «Uniswap · uniswap».

description: Read fixed registry identity and dependency information: project names, aliases, contracts, official accounts and sources, plus registered causal dependencies. Filter by token_id or entity_id, or omit both for the whole registry. Registry links identify candidates; they do not alone prove a current integration, economic effect or token capture.
